caption: The drawing depicts a single object: a horse-drawn sleigh with curved runners. The sleigh is primarily pink in color, with areas where the paint appears chipped or weathered, exposing patches of a duller, underlying layer. Yellow trim outlines the edges and panels of the sleigh, adding a contrasting border. The body of the sleigh is made up of angled wooden panels, and the sides feature decorative circular patterns at the front and back. The runners and structural elements beneath the passenger compartment are also painted pink, and are reinforced with crossbars and curved metalwork. The background is plain and off-white, and there are no other objects or additional details present in the composition.
title: Sleigh
